# anthropic_workspace (Resource)

Manages a Claude Console workspace (`/v1/organizations/workspaces`). Deleting this resource archives the workspace (`POST /v1/organizations/workspaces/{id}/archive`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_workspace" "production" {
  name = "production-inference"

  data_residency = {
    workspace_geo          = "us"
    default_inference_geo  = "us"
    allowed_inference_geos = ["us", "global"]
  }
}

resource "anthropic_workspace_member" "lead_developer" {
  workspace_id   = anthropic_workspace.production.id
  user_id        = "user_01J9ABCDEF"
  workspace_role = "workspace_admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the workspace.

### Optional

- `data_residency` (Attributes) Data residency and inference geography configuration for the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_residency))

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the workspace was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the workspace was created.
- `display_color` (String) Console display color assigned to the workspace.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`workspace`).

<a id="nestedatt--data_residency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_residency`

Optional:

- `allowed_inference_geos` (Set of String) Allowed geographies for model inference (e.g. `["us"]`, `["us", "global"]`, or `["unrestricted"]`).
- `default_inference_geo` (String) Default geography used for model inference (`us` or `global`).
- `workspace_geo` (String) Geographic region where workspace data is stored at rest (e.g. `us`). Immutable after creation.
